reference: Say bye now and she will come back in an hour.
sk: Rozlúč sa a o hodinu sa vráti naspäť.
cz: Rozluč se a za hodinu se vrátí zpátky.
acceptable: Say {bye|goodbye}{ now|} and she will {come back|return|be back} in an hour.
Say {bye|goodbye}{ now|} and in an hour she will {come back|return|be back}.

mistakes.text: Say {bye|goodbye}{ now|} and she comes back in an hour.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pre budúcnosť tu patrí „will“: „will come back“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pro budoucnost sem patří „will“: „will come back“.

mistakes.text: Say {bye|goodbye}{ now|} and she will comes back in an hour.
Say {bye|goodbye}{ now|} and she will come back after an hour.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „O hodinu“ = „in an hour“, nie „after an hour“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Za hodinu“ = „in an hour“, ne „after an hour“.

mistakes.text: Say {bye|goodbye}{ now|} and she will come back in a hour.
Say {bye|goodbye}{ now|} and she will return back in an hour.

source_issues: EN has 'now' which SK/CZ lack; answers with and without 'now' accepted.
